query: What are the main types of concerns patients come in with in these visit notes?

per_column.name: clinical_category
per_column.rationale: Directly answers the query by categorizing the type of concern; samples map soundly (acne->dermatologic, cough->infectious, knee->musculoskeletal). Strong grouping axis.

per_column.name: visit_purpose
per_column.rationale: Distinguishes acute vs chronic vs wellness visits, a useful complementary axis. Mostly well grounded, though acne labeled chronic_disease_management is a defensible but slightly loose reading.

per_column.name: problem_acuity
per_column.rationale: Ordinal severity gives modelable leverage, but partly overlaps existing 'urgency' column. Values are plausible inferences from text, though the 1-5 scale is somewhat subjective/underspecified.

per_column.name: chronicity
per_column.rationale: New-onset vs chronic-stable is a genuine analytical axis for concern types. Sample reads are sound (viral URI new_onset, post-MI chronic_stable).

per_column.name: care_action_type
per_column.rationale: Captures the response/action, useful for characterizing visits. Grounded in text (adapalene->medication_initiation, MRI->diagnostic_workup). Slightly tangential to 'concern type' but adds leverage.

per_column.name: body_system
per_column.rationale: Well grounded but substantially redundant with clinical_category (cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, skin largely mirror each other), reducing analytical novelty for this query.

per_column.name: symptom_mechanism
per_column.rationale: Pathophysiologic mechanism is a distinct, non-trivial axis. Sample reads reasonable (twisting injury->traumatic, post-MI->ischemic). Some inference risk but warranted.

per_column.name: referral_or_escalation
per_column.rationale: Useful disposition axis. Mostly grounded, though labeling the annual-physical (labs ordered) and knee-MRI rows as 'ancillary_referral_only' is a stretch—ordering labs/imaging is not clearly a referral, a mild over-read.

per_column.name: preventive_flag
per_column.rationale: Flags preventive/screening content, a reasonable axis somewhat overlapping visit_purpose. Well grounded (annual physical->screening; silent rows correctly not_present).

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively give strong, multi-axis leverage for characterizing patient concerns—clinical_category directly answers the query, while chronicity, visit_purpose, symptom_mechanism, and care_action_type add genuinely different grouping dimensions. body_system is the weakest, being largely redundant with clinical_category. Values are generally sound readings of the source text, with only minor over-reads (referral labels for lab/imaging orders). Silent rows are handled correctly with 'not_present'. No clear hallucinations observed.
